name: Robot going for a stroll V07
description: The robot is rebuilt from Quick Detail "Robot Sketch 2": round body with a chest panel of nine lights, round head, long antenna and long tail, four limbs. It walks the Robot Path 2 walk with the banana. No hat, frisbee or cape (not in the sketch). Path from Quick Detail "Robot Path 2" (fd1878e1-ac12-4355-afee-3ebeeb07d4d9).
